vedic_reference.note: Disha is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'dish' which means 'direction'. It is also associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is often depicted as the preserver and protector of the universe. The name Disha signifies 'the one who leads, the guide'. In Hindu mythology, Vishnu is often referred to as 'Dhishana', which means 'the one who is the direction-giver'. Thus, the name Disha is deeply rooted in the rich cultural and spiritual traditions of India.
